editorial:
You get five married friends who secretly share a fancy city penthouse for affairs, and everything feels slick and dangerous until a dead woman is found in their bed. The story pulls you into their panic as each man tries to protect himself and blame someone else. The mood is tense, glossy, and full of suspicion, with lots of sharp conversations and shifting loyalties. You may not love every character, but the setup keeps you guessing about who is lying and why.

The acting is solid, especially when the men turn on each other, and the pacing moves quickly enough to keep you engaged. The twists are fun, though some moments feel a little over-the-top and the characters can be hard to root for. If you enjoy twisty thrillers with secrets, betrayals, and a locked-room feel, this is a good pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the friends piece together the timeline and realize the dead woman was killed by one of their own, not an outsider. The killer confesses that he planned the murder and tried to frame another man, using the loft and their secrets against them. The twist reveals hidden motives, including a secret love and a cover-up, and the group is left broken as the truth comes out.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves twisty thrillers with secrets and betrayals.
